summary: Fail against w17 (8.5). The seam bead comes back as a w16-type rod in the main paired view. In q14_seat26A, the foreground seat's back has a solid black cord along the shell's inner edge from y 180 to the bottom of the frame: 7-8 px wide at L 4-22 (L 4-5 below y 320). In py_37303 the same junction is a 2-3 px dip to L 60-65. The cause is in the code: gTube(run, 0.004, 4) is a radius, so the bead is 8 mm across (not 4 mm), square in section, and sampled at only 16 steps over 0.88 m. The chords cut across the curved shell edge and leave the cord standing proud. Further away the bead works as intended: a 1-2 px sliver in q13 (x 344-360, y 339-541), p8 (x 383-389), p7 and the mid seats in q14 (2 px at L 10-30), which is the outline dark the integration rater asked for. Change 2 (the lighter #4a505e upper step) is invisible. Luma profiles across the cushion-nose band are pixel-identical before and after in p8 (x 200 / 440) and p5 (x 150 / 500): the step is fully hidden by the cushion overhang, so the w17 medium is not fixed. Change 3 (cubby mouths L 19 -> 7 in p5) is correct but marginal. Keep it.
lighting_note: Not scored. The bead's colour #2a2e36 renders at L 4-20 in the shaded corner, where the photo's junction is L 60-65. The shading pushes it near-black, so its colour should be lighter than the 'renders L45-60' comment assumes.

issues.fix: In 09b_py.js, make the bead gTube(run, 0.0015, 6). Use 40 or more seamPath steps, or resample each run every 15 mm, and pull each point about 1 mm into the shell (along -grad shellSD) so the chords cannot stand proud of the curved edge. Lighten PYGROOVE to about #3a3f48 so that the corner shadow yields about L 50-65. Recheck q14 row 350: the target is ≤3 px at L ≥ 45.

questions: Is the q14 bead the aisle-side (sd=+1) run of the nearest seat? If it is, the seam point could be computed on the wrong side of the shell's rounded corner there (the cushion enters the shell's side, not its front). Clamping the bead to the front face, |x| < w/2 - r, would also stop it from riding round the edge.

before_vs_after.verdict: Do not ship as is. Keep w17 unless the bead is fixed; with the thinner, sunk bead this should reach 8.6.
